data.gender_notes: Irfana is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is sincere and faithful to Allah, trustworthy, truthful. The name Irfana carries the meaning “Faithful, sincere” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Irfana usually hope their child will grow to embody faithful, sincere and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Irfana belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Faithful, sincere.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Irfana total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: إرفانا
in_arabic.long_meaning: الحسّ النبيل والروح النزيه والسماع الحسّان، هي أصل الكلم إرفانا في اللغة العربية، والذي عادةً ما يعود إلى مصدر إرفان، بمعنى الحسّ والروح، حيث يُشير إلى الإحساس الروحي والوضوح الذهني، وهو ما يحقق في الفرد بالتوفيق والنجاح في حياته.

in_urdu.name: عرفانا
in_urdu.long_meaning: بھرپور جذبہ اور خوش نصیبی، اردو میں نام ارفانا کا مطلب عرفان سے ملتا ہے۔ یہ لفظ عرفان کا مصدر ہے، جس کے معنی جذبہ اور خوش نصیبی کے ہیں۔ اس نام کا انتخاب کرنا ایک بہت سی وجوہات کے ساتھ ہوتا ہے، جیسے کہ اس کے معنوں میں خوش نصیبی اور بھرپور جذبہ شامل ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इरफ़ाना
in_hindi.long_meaning: इरफ़ाना नाम का अर्थ है बड़ा ही अच्छा शुभ लक्षण। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है अच्छा शुभ लक्षण। इस नाम का चयन करने के कई कारण होते हैं, जैसे कि इसके अर्थ में अच्छा शुभ लक्षण शामिल है।

in_english.name: Irfana
in_english.long_meaning: Pleasant intellect and good fortune, Irfana is an Arabic name meaning pleasant intellect and good fortune. The name is derived from the root word 'irfan' meaning intellect and good fortune. Irfana is a name that combines the qualities of a pleasant intellect and good fortune, making it a popular choice among Muslims.

data.cultural_impact: The name Irfana carries a rich cultural heritage as it signifies someone who is both sincere and trustworthy, recalling the importance of being truthful and maintaining high moral standards not only for yourself but for the benefit of your community. In many Muslim cultures, the name Irfana would be passed on from one generation to another as a source of inspiration and a reminder to instill these values in upcoming generations.
data.spiritual_significance: For Muslims, the name Irfana holds significant spiritual importance as it underlines the pursuit for truth and attaining a deeper understanding of Allah, guided by the principle of Tawheed – the Oneness of God. The sincere intention behind all actions and an unwavering commitment to remain faithful to Allah's will is an essential part of a Muslim's spiritual growth. This name, therefore, serves as a constant reminder of the importance of seeking inner purity and continually working towards pleasing Allah in every aspect of one's life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Faithful, sincere" symbolizes One who is sincere and faithful to Allah, trustworthy, truthful. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Irfana serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of faithful, sincere.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Irfana is mentioned in the works of medieval Islamic scholars as a variant of the name Irfan. The name Irfana carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Irfana is associated with the Sufi tradition and is mentioned in the works of scholars such as Al-Ghazali.

trends: increasing popularity in the Middle East and South Asia
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Irfana remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
